results.query: Economist YouGov latest Trump job approval

results.content:
In the latest Economist/YouGov survey, Trump is exiting August with a 33 percent approval rating, a new low for him in that poll.

Trump’s polling in the Decision Desk HQ (DDHQ) average did see a slight increase Thursday, reaching 39.2 percent.

Still, this average marked the second-lowest released by DDHQ since May, when Trump averaged 38 percent. The polling average also found that 57.5 percent disapproved of the president.

Trump's age continues to concern many Americans, with 53% saying they believe the 80-year-old president is too old to serve in the White House. Additionally, 69% said they feel that things in the country are "out of control."
